s_design.evidence_quote: Using the FEA software ANSYS Workbench R2023, the 3D model of the bone block and implants was discretized with tetrahedral elements.

domains.evidence_quote: The null hypothesis states that implant positioning relative to the alveolar crest does not influence the stress distribution.

domains.note: Absence. Read Methods 2, 2.1 FEA Modeling and 2.2 Load and Boundary Conditions, plus Results 3 to 3.2. Each configuration (A to D) is a single deterministic model. The mesh sensitivity analysis concerns element size, not the number of models or specimens. No sample, replicate or power wording appears anywhere in the text.

Absence. Read Methods 2 to 2.2 and Results. The four configurations are designed models, and no allocation or assignment procedure is described. No random or allocation wording appears anywhere in the text.

Absence. Read Methods 2 to 2.2, Results 3 to 3.2 and Author Contributions. Neither modelling nor the reading of stress outputs is described as blinded or independently assessed. No blind or masked wording appears anywhere in the text.

Absence. Read Methods 2 to 2.2 and Results 3 to 3.2. The outcomes are single peak von Mises values per model. No statistical test, variance, confidence interval or uncertainty/sensitivity analysis of the outputs is reported. 'Significant' appears only for mesh refinement and in cited literature.

sources.interpretation_fa: این مرور سیستماتیک در PROSPERO ثبت شده و در سه پایگاه داده جست‌وجو کرده است. اما چکیده درباره‌ی ارزیابی risk of bias مطالعات، فهرست مطالعات حذف‌شده و publication bias چیزی نمی‌گوید و نوع مطالعات واردشده را هم مشخص نمی‌کند. یافته‌ها این است که marginal bone loss و عوارض پروتزی تفاوتی نداشتند و survival در ترمیم‌های splinted بالاتر بود. این یافته‌ها فعلاً در حد شواهد محدود قابل اتکا هستند.
